content: matchedGeometryEffect is the standard technique for animating the selection indicator (sliding pill/underline) within a custom segmented control, distinct from content-pane transitions. For content-pane transitions between differently-shaped views (List vs ScrollView/grid), asymmetric .transition + directional .move(edge:) driven by comparing previous vs new selection index is the common approach; there is no single first-party API that infers direction automatically.
